"""A former-root binding used other than as ``binding.attr``: patched, passed, read with vars()."""

from unittest import mock

from threetears.evals import kernel, providers
from threetears.evals import host as evals_host


def test_patched(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers, "PriceRefresh", object)
    with mock.patch.object(kernel, "EvalServiceError", RuntimeError):
        assert evals_host.ValidationFailedError
    print(vars(kernel))
